image_description: An open, grey plastic tri-fold case containing a survival and utility kit. The left panel holds a knife and drill bits; the center contains a hammer, screwdriver, tape measure, rope, and flashlight; the right panel features a red booklet titled 'ZOMBIE SURVIVAL KIT USERS MANUAL'.

artifact_observations.location: Red manual on the right panel
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text 'ZOMBIE SURVIVAL KIT USERS MANUAL' is legible but has slight character irregularities and kerning issues typical of AI generation. The logo below it is indistinct/melting.
The geometry of the hammer head is slightly warped; the claw does not have a sharp, functional edge and appears fused with the handle neck.
The rope lacks distinct fiber detail, appearing as a smooth, plastic-like torus rather than twisted fibers.

To check for fusion artifacts between the tools and the plastic molding, especially around the hammer head.
To assess overall lighting consistency and detect subtle texture anomalies in the plastic casing.
